```{=html}
<style>
.w031 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w031 .w031-pool {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w031 .w031-buckets { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w031 .w031-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 180px; min-height: 150px; padding: 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w031 .w031-bucket.w031-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w031 .w031-btitle { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.w031 .w031-bdesc { text-align: center; font-size: 0.8rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.75; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w031 .w031-drop { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center; min-height: 34px; }
.w031 .w031-chip {
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
}
.w031 .w031-chip.w031-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w031 .w031-chip.w031-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w031 .w031-chip.w031-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w031 .w031-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w031 button.w031-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w031 .w031-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w031 .w031-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w031 .w031-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w031 .w031-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w031 .w031-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w031 iw" id="w031">
  <div class="w031-pool" aria-label="attack characteristics to classify"></div>
  <div class="w031-buckets">
    <div class="w031-bucket" data-cat="vol">
      <div class="w031-btitle">Volumetric</div>
      <div class="w031-bdesc">saturates the<br>network link</div>
      <div class="w031-drop"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w031-bucket" data-cat="proto">
      <div class="w031-btitle">Protocol</div>
      <div class="w031-bdesc">exhausts<br>connection state</div>
      <div class="w031-drop"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w031-bucket" data-cat="app">
      <div class="w031-btitle">Application-layer</div>
      <div class="w031-bdesc">exhausts the<br>application itself</div>
      <div class="w031-drop"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w031-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w031-btn w031-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w031-btn w031-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w031-btn w031-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w031-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w031-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w031-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Volumetric attacks saturate the network link — UDP floods with amplification, measured in gigabits or terabits per second. Protocol attacks exhaust connection state — the SYN flood, measured in packets per second. Application-layer attacks exhaust the application itself — a flood against a search endpoint — and are hardest to tell apart from real users. See <a href="#def-ddos">the definition of DoS and DDoS</a> in <a href="#sec-03-denial-of-service">the section on denial of service</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w031');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w031-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w031-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w031-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['SYN flood', 'proto'],
    ['flood against a search endpoint', 'app'],
    ['UDP flood with amplification', 'vol'],
    ['measured in packets per second', 'proto'],
    ['hardest to tell apart from real users', 'app'],
    ['measured in gigabits or terabits per second', 'vol']
  ];
  let picked = null;

  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w031-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w031-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w031-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w031-right', 'w031-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w031-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) {
    bucket.querySelector('.w031-drop').appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  function makeChip(label, cat, i) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w031-chip';
    c.textContent = label;
    c.dataset.cat = cat;
    c.dataset.id = 'w031i' + i;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w031-picked');
      buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w031-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', c.dataset.id));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(bucket => {
    bucket.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(bucket, picked); unpick(); } });
    bucket.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    bucket.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w031-chip[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(bucket, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w031-chip[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w031-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, unplaced = 0;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w031-chip').forEach(c => {
      c.classList.remove('w031-right', 'w031-wrong');
      if (c.parentElement === pool) { unplaced++; return; }
      const bucket = c.closest('.w031-bucket');
      if (c.dataset.cat === bucket.dataset.cat) { c.classList.add('w031-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w031-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — the three DDoS types are sorted.'; msg.className = 'w031-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unplaced > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + unplaced + ' item(s) still unplaced.'; msg.className = 'w031-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red items are in the wrong type.'; msg.className = 'w031-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w031-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    root.querySelectorAll('.w031-chip').forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.cat === c.dataset.cat);
      if (bucket) place(bucket, c);
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('.w031-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.add('w031-right'));
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w031-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w031-expl').hidden = false;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w031-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w031-chip').forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w031-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it[0], it[1], i)));
})();
</script>
```
